classification.difficultyReason: 1E Q24: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. The sum of the equal sides must exceed the 10 cm base; no triangle diagram is supplied.

content.prompt: An isosceles triangle has two sides of length $x$ cm and a base of $10$ cm. What values can $x$ take?

answer.short: $x>5$; the equal sides must each exceed $5$ cm.
answer.worked:
The sum of the equal sides must exceed the base.

$$\begin{align*}x+x&>10\\2x&>10\\x&>5\end{align*}$$

The other two triangle inequalities reduce to $10>0$. Thus each equal side must exceed $5$ cm.
